candidates.why_relevant: DSI is Slovenia's flagship informatics conference; its tiered sponsor list (general/diamond/gold/silver/bronze/media) is a paid, dated declaration of which IT vendors are courting Slovenian enterprise and public-sector buyers, including banks. Observed tiers in 2026 include NIL d.o.o. (general), Lek (HackathON diamond), Microsoft (gold), 3 GEN, Bplanet, Comtrade, DELL, Endava (silver).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual HTML scrape of each year's sponsor page; site uses a per-year subdomain pattern (dsiYYYY.dsi-konferenca.si), so archive editions 2021-2026 for time-series vendor tracking.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language web search + fetch of DSI 2026 program page which linked the sponsors page
queries_used: Dnevi slovenske informatike program predavatelji sponzorji

candidates.source_name: Dnevi slovenske informatike – programme and speakers (govorci)
candidates.why_relevant: Agenda and speaker list names vendor speakers alongside bank/public-sector executives; 2026 tracks include AI, digital public services, cybersecurity, data management. Speaker affiliation is a leading indicator of vendor-bank relationships before deals are announced.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape programme + govorci + delavnice pages per edition; extract speaker name/title/organisation triples.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of DSI 2026 programme page
queries_used: Dnevi slovenske informatike program predavatelji sponzorji

candidates.source_name: Slovensko društvo Informatika (SDI) – event organiser page
candidates.why_relevant: SDI organises DSI and awards; its events section is the upstream announcement channel for editions, calls for papers, and award ceremonies, useful for discovering new event instances and sub-events (hackathon sponsors, award categories).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /dogodek/ listing to detect new conference editions and award announcements.
queries_used: Dnevi slovenske informatike program predavatelji sponzorji

candidates.why_relevant: The central annual Slovenian banking conference (Brdo pri Kranju; 2026 edition 3 June, theme on geopolitics, digitalisation and 'new' sovereignty). Panel line-ups name Bank of Slovenia vice-governors, KDD IT directors and bank executives — the exact buyer population vendors target — and any commercial partners of the event.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scrape of the conference page plus the ZBS news feed post-event write-up which lists speakers and panel participants.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl web search on ZBS conference terms; snowballed to ZBS news write-up of the 2026 edition
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS konferenca bančništvo program
Finance konferenca bančništvo digitalizacija Slovenija 2026 partnerji dogodek

candidates.why_relevant: Forward calendar of every ZBS conference, posvetovanje and training for the year — the single best pointer for scheduling collection of Slovenian banking events, including the card-business consultation and treasurer/back-office consultations where payments vendors present.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape; diff against previous snapshot to detect new event types.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije ZBS konferenca bančništvo program

candidates.source_name: ZBS posvetovanje o kartičnem poslovanju (card business consultation)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual consultation aimed at leading and expert staff in card business at banks, savings banks and other institutions. This is the narrowest, highest-signal Slovenian gathering for cards/payments vendors; its agenda names who is invited to speak about card innovations and trends.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the yearly event entry via terminski-plan, then capture the agenda PDF/page; a dedicated stable URL for this consultation was not confirmed in this pass.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl web search snowballed from ZBS training centre description
queries_used: posvetovanje kartično poslovanje ZBS Portorož banke ponudniki

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik (ZBS journal) – conference proceedings and special issues
candidates.why_relevant: The only Slovenian monthly journal for money and banking (since 1951, EconLit-indexed). Special/English issues frequently package conference contributions, and article authorship reveals which vendors and consultancies get platformed by ZBS. Useful as the written residue of events whose agendas are otherwise ephemeral.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest free articles and English special-issue PDFs; index tables of contents only for paywalled issues. Do not redistribute full text.
queries_used: "Bančni vestnik" konferenca ZBS dogodek plačilni promet Slovenija
candidates.observed_blocker: Login/subscription gate on parts of bv.zbs-giz.si

candidates.source_name: ZBS letno poročilo (annual report) – event and working-group record
candidates.why_relevant: Retrospective, dated record of which conferences, consultations and working groups ZBS actually ran, with counts and themes — lets a collector reconstruct historical event series that no longer have live pages.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download and text extraction of the education/events chapter.
queries_used: "Bančni vestnik" konferenca ZBS dogodek plačilni promet Slovenija

candidates.why_relevant: The dominant regional (Adriatic/SEE) fintech and payments conference, co-founded by ASEE and Monri; sponsors observed include Nexi, Mastercard, OTP Bank, Monri, ASEE, Payten. Slovenian banks and vendors attend, and the sponsor tiering is the clearest paid signal of regional payments-vendor intent affecting the SI market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape sponsors, speakers, agenda and startup pages each edition; archived editions live at year subdomains (e.g. 2025.money-motion.eu). Sponsor names are rendered as logo images — expect OCR or alt-text extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en web search + fetch of the expo page (which lists nav to Sponsors/Speakers/Agenda/Startups)
queries_used: Money Motion konferenca plačila Zagreb sponsors exhibitors

candidates.why_relevant: 2,000 m2 expo with 30+ exhibitors — a near-complete vendor census for regional payments at a point in time. Fetched directly: the page is promotional and does NOT name exhibitors, so the exhibitor roster must be recovered from the event app, floorplan or press coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Combine with the Money Motion mobile app listing and post-event press write-ups (e.g. asee.io newsroom) to reconstruct the exhibitor roster.
queries_used: Money Motion konferenca plačila Zagreb sponsors exhibitors

candidates.source_name: PayTech.Events / European Digital Finance Association event listings
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party aggregators of payments-industry events with dates, agendas and links; useful for discovering regional payments events (beyond Money Motion) that Slovenian vendors and banks attend, and for backfilling past editions.

candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's largest information-security conference (24th edition, Nova Gorica, Sept 2026) with an explicit sponsor tier and exhibitor list — observed names include Cloudflare (general sponsor), ADD, CreaPlus, Delinea, Kaspersky, Kontron, Omicron, Sophos. Banks are a core buyer segment for these vendors; security-vendor visibility spend maps directly onto bank fraud/cyber procurement.

candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian security-media outlet that files post-event reports naming award recipients, sponsors and attendance figures; recovers detail that conference sites delete after the edition ends.

candidates.why_relevant: The most complete Slovenian IT-event calendar, with per-event pages for DSI, INFOSEK, CIO Summit, NT konferenca, Industrijski forum IRT. Best single pointer for discovering Slovenian conferences where banking/payments vendors buy visibility, and for dates/venues.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of /koledar/ and /dogodek/* pages; snowball each event to its own sponsor/exhibitor page.

negative_findings.description: Fetched https://www.money-motion.eu/expo/ directly. Despite claiming 30+ exhibitors and 2,000 m2 of expo space, the page names no exhibitor or sponsor at all — it is a promotional landing page with a lead-capture form.
negative_findings.result_summary: Exhibitor census for the most important regional payments event is not machine-readable from the expo page; it must be reconstructed from the event mobile app, the separate /sponsors/ page (logo images), and post-event press coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Exhibitor lists are the completest vendor censuses in this cell; if the primary site withholds them, collection must be multi-source and will be lossier.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovenian for a standalone Slovenian payments/cards conference (konferenca plačila, plačilni promet, kartično poslovanje) analogous to Croatia's Money Motion. None was found. The closest is the ZBS internal posvetovanje o kartičnem poslovanju, which is a member consultation rather than a public trade fair with an exhibitor floor.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenia appears to have no independent public payments trade fair; vendor visibility flows instead through ZBS member events, general IT conferences (DSI, INFOSEK, NT) and the regional Money Motion in Zagreb.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection strategy must accept that Slovenian payments-vendor visibility is distributed across generic IT events and a foreign regional event, not concentrated in one national show.

negative_findings.description: ZBS pages for Bančna konferenca and the professional consultations describe programme and audience but no sponsor/partner tier was surfaced in this pass. Similarly, no sponsor list was surfaced for Dnevi zavarovalništva v Sloveniji.
negative_findings.result_summary: Industry-association events in SI appear to run on membership fees rather than visible sponsor tiers, so 'paid declaration of intent' signal is weaker here than at commercial conferences.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For ZBS/SZZ events the usable signal is the speaker/panel roster and post-event write-ups, not sponsorship; collection rules should differ per event type.

negative_findings.description: Search results attribute the Netko award both to Slovensko društvo Informatika (historically) and to GZS together with Register.si (current). The official netko.si site was not fetched in this pass to resolve the discrepancy.
negative_findings.result_summary: Netko stewardship is unresolved; recorded as a hypothesis, not a fact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Getting the organiser wrong misroutes collection and misattributes the award's credibility.

negative_findings.description: WEBSI awards were only evidenced through media coverage (siol.net, metropolitan.si, zurnal24, branddna.si, superznamka.si). The canonical WEBSI domain (websi.si) was inferred, not fetched or confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: WEBSI recorded with confidence 0.6 and access_status unverified pending a liveness check.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The winners archive is the durable artefact; if the official site does not host one, the media mirrors become the primary source.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovenian-language term or dedicated venue was found for a 'payments trade fair' / 'exhibitor list' in the financial-sector sense. 'Razstavljavci' returns results only for general IT/security events (INFOSEK, CYBER & INFOSECURITY), never for banking events.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language vocabulary for this cell is borrowed from the general IT-event domain, which shapes which queries can work.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for future runs should route through IT-event vocabulary plus bank-audience filters rather than payments-fair vocabulary, which does not exist locally.

negative_findings.description: Searched for an 'SBC digital summit' with fintech sponsors/exhibitors; SBC (Klub slovenskih podjetnikov) runs webinars and press conferences but no fintech-focused summit with a published exhibitor roster was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: SBC downgraded to an indirect, low-priority source (member directory and event partners only).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting a cell seed that does not correspond to a real exhibitor-bearing event.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor and exhibitor rosters are typically deleted or replaced when a conference site rolls to the next edition. DSI is the exception (per-year subdomains 2021-2026); Money Motion partly (year subdomains); most others keep only the current edition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill via Wayback Machine snapshots of sponsor/exhibitor pages for INFOSEK, NT konferenca, CIO Summit, Money Motion and the Finance conference portfolio before running forward collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Sponsor tiers on Money Motion, INFOSEK and DSI are rendered as logo images, sometimes without informative alt text, so plain HTML scraping will under-recover vendor names.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an image/OCR + logo-matching step into the collection method for sponsor pages, and cross-validate against post-event press coverage naming sponsors in text.

coverage_gaps.description: NT konferenca, CIO Summit and WEBSI were reached only via a media calendar or press coverage; their canonical organiser domains were not confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve official domains for NT konferenca (organiser believed to be Kompas Xnet), CIO Summit Slovenia, and WEBSI, then re-scope those candidates to their primary sites.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-signal Slovenian payments gathering (ZBS posvetovanje o kartičnem poslovanju) is a member consultation whose detailed agenda may not be published openly; only a descriptive blurb was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Attempt to retrieve annual agenda PDFs from the ZBS terminski plan and vsa-izobrazevanja pages; if gated, fall back to the ZBS letno poročilo which records events retrospectively, and to attendee LinkedIn posts.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Money Motion was covered on the regional axis. Other Adriatic/CEE payments and banking events that Slovenian banks attend (e.g. Croatian, Serbian and Austrian banking/cards conferences) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep using paytech.events, europeandigitalfinance.eu and 10times filtered to HR/RS/AT/HU, then check which Slovenian institutions appear on their speaker lists.

coverage_gaps.description: No social-listening source was recorded for conference attendance, which in practice is where Slovenian vendor and bank staff self-declare presence at events (booth photos, 'we are at X' posts).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a LinkedIn/company-newsroom monitoring rule keyed to event hashtags and Slovenian vendor pages, as a complement to official sponsor pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Only DIGGIT was confirmed to have an explicit financial-services/insurance/banking award category. Whether WEBSI, Netko and GZS innovation awards carry a finance-specific category was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the rules/category pages for WEBSI, Netko and GZS priznanja to determine whether finance-specific filtering is possible, or whether full winner lists must be classified post hoc.

brief: Slovenia has no standalone national payments trade fair, so vendor visibility in this cell is split three ways: association events (ZBS Bančna konferenca at Brdo and the members-only posvetovanje o kartičnem poslovanju) that publish speakers but not sponsors; general IT and security conferences (Dnevi slovenske informatike, INFOSEK, NT konferenca, CIO Summit) that do publish tiered sponsor and exhibitor lists and where bank-serving integrators buy presence; and the regional Money Motion in Zagreb, co-founded by ASEE and Monri and sponsored by Nexi, Mastercard, OTP and Payten, which functions as the de facto Adriatic payments expo. Award programmes (DIGGIT, WEBSI, Netko, GZS priznanja za inovacije) are the strongest disclosed vendor-client evidence, since entries name the client, the agency and the technology partner together — DIGGIT even carries an explicit financial-services/insurance/banking category. The main collection risks are logo-image sponsor walls, per-edition deletion of rosters (only DSI keeps clean per-year subdomains), and the fact that the single highest-signal cards event is a closed member consultation best reconstructed from the ZBS terminski plan and annual report.
